name: Ichigin Fuuga
source:
Blue Pride Route

A fourth-year student in the Faculty of Law at Higashihashi University.

A high-achiever who has garnered media attention, including being selected as “Mr. Higashihashi.”

He has a passion for the law and prefers to live in accordance with it.
